_doc.how_to_use: Copy to config/csv-mapping.json. Set "preset" to one of the names under "presets", then add any keys below at the top level to override that preset. Run: python3 scripts/normalize_csv.py inbox/file.csv --mapping config/csv-mapping.json --out data/trades.csv
_doc.kind: "fills" (one row per execution; matched FIFO into round trips) or "round_trips" (one row per finished trade).
_doc.columns: Canonical field -> the CSV's column name. Fills: symbol, side (optional if qty is signed), qty, price, time, fees, account, order_id, asset_class. Round trips: symbol, side, qty, entry_time, exit_time, entry_price, exit_price, fees, pnl_gross, account, order_id; or buy_time, sell_time, buy_price, sell_price instead of side/entry/exit (side is then derived from which came first).
_doc.date_format: Python strptime format, "iso" for ISO 8601, or "epoch_ms". Times without an offset are read in "timezone" (override with --timezone).
_doc.time_strip_regex: Optional regex removed from time cells before parsing (for example a trailing timezone name).
_doc.header_row_contains: Optional list of column names; skips leading report sections until the row that has them all, and stops at the next blank line.
_doc.row_filter: Optional {column: [allowed values]}; other rows are ignored (for example only Filled orders).
_doc.side_values: Optional {buy: [...], sell: [...]}; case-insensitive. Defaults cover B/Buy/Bot/Bought and S/Sell/Sld/Sold.
_doc.asset_class: stock | option | future | crypto | forex | other. Default for every row.
_doc.asset_class_values: Optional map from a per-row asset class column's values to the above, e.g. {"FUT": "future"}.
_doc.multipliers: Optional {ROOT: dollars per point} that adds to or overrides the built-in futures table (CL 1000, MCL 100, GC 100, MGC 10, NG 10000, ES 50, MES 5, NQ 20, MNQ 2, ZC/ZS/ZW 50, and more). Options default to 100. Everything else is 1.
_doc.fee_per_unit_per_side: Used only when the file has no fees column: dollars per contract or share per side.
_doc.source: Written to the source column, for example csv:tradovate.
_doc.verified: true = column names were checked against a real export. false = taken from the vendor's documented layout or memory; run one file and check the numbers before trusting it.

generic_round_trip.notes: Already one row per trade. Header: account,symbol,side,qty,entry_time,exit_time,entry_price,exit_price,fees. Times in ISO 8601.

tradovate_performance.notes: Tradovate Account Reports > Performance > Export CSV (one row per round trip). Column names from Tradovate's documented export (fill ids, buy/sell prices, bought/sold timestamps); not checked against a real file. The pnl column is ignored and recomputed from prices and the multiplier table. No commission column: set fee_per_unit_per_side.

tradovate_orders_fills.notes: Tradovate Orders export (one row per order; the avg fill price and filled qty are used as one fill). Column names from memory of the Orders report; not checked against a real file. Only rows with Status = Filled are used.

ninjatrader_trade_performance.notes: NinjaTrader 8 Trade Performance grid > right-click > Export. One row per trade. Column names from the documented grid; not checked against a real export. Profit and commission columns are ignored for pnl; pnl is recomputed from prices. Check the time format (12-hour with AM/PM assumed).

thinkorswim_account_statement.notes: thinkorswim > Monitor > Account Statement > Export. The file has several sections; the Account Trade History block is found by its header row. Stocks, with a signed Qty. Not checked against a real export. Dates are two-digit-year (11/16/26 09:42:10).

ibkr_flex_trades.notes: IBKR Flex Query (Trades section) as CSV with fields ClientAccountID, AssetClass, Symbol, DateTime, Quantity, TradePrice, IBCommission, Buy/Sell, Multiplier. Date format 'yyyyMMdd;HHmmss' must be chosen in the Flex query. Not checked against a real export. Commission comes as a negative number; the sign is dropped. For futures set the Symbol field to the contract (e.g. CLZ6).

webull_orders.notes: Webull app/web > Orders > Export. Filled orders only. Column names from memory; not checked against a real file. Times carry a trailing zone name such as EST, which is stripped; set timezone to the account's zone. No commission column.
